messages:
Anika: omg walked into the laundry room and found them like this 😭🧺🥺
ops-bot: uploaded file: laundry-bunnies.jpg
Rahul: immediate heart explosion. are those two different buns or one bun + blanket burrito? 🎃
Anika: two buns. Toast (orange) + Nug (gray). Nug stole the scarf and now Toast is a literal pumpkin burrito.
Jess: pics or it didn't happen 👀
Anika: https://redwood-pics.internal/pumpkin_burrito.jpg (low effort caption: 'laundry day heroics')
Maya: the ear flop on Nug is criminal. i can't. :heart_eyes:
Rahul: caption contest: 'Laundry: 1. Humans: 0.' i'm voting this 10/10
Anika: they were snoring. tried to pick Toast up to move laundry, Toast offended and tightened burrito grip. mission failed.
Jess: stealing this for my wallpaper, will credit the buns. :raised_hands:
Anika: please do. also if anyone wants a physical print i will absolutely fund a 'bunny in a basket' calendar.
Maya: subscribe me to the calendar. also can we have a company-wide poll: who brings more joy, Toast or Nug? :joy:
Rahul: both. it's unfair to choose.
ops-bot: reaction: :thumbsup: from Jess, Rahul
Anika: thanks all. sharing because i needed a small victory today and these two delivered.
